subject: Hosted -> Dedicated migration: cutover sanity + swarm staffing
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara@stratusml.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 01 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted -> Dedicated migration: sizing check + proposed cutover week

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier this week. As we talked about, StratusML is planning to move our high-throughput inference traffic from Redwood's hosted API to a Dedicated pool for month-to-month predictability and lower sustained cost. Before we lock the PO, your team asked for a final sizing validation and a proposed cutover window that minimizes risk to our east-coast customers.

Quick surface-level metrics from our side:
- Avg QPS (30d): 120 rps (text-generation)
- 95th percentile concurrent sequences: 85
- Average prompt+response tokens: ~420 tokens
- Preferred model: rdx-7b-q4 (they prefer quantized variant for cost)
- Latency SLO: 1500ms p95
- Peak daily window: 1600–2200 EST (highest traffic)

Attached is our capacity matrix (stratus_capacity_matrix_v2.xlsx) and a short runbook excerpt.

What we need from you to confirm:
1) Acceptable Dedicated pool size (GPU count + vRAM assumptions) for an initial commit that meets the SLOs with 20% headroom.
2) A proposed 72-hour (best-effort) cutover timeline with canary steps and rollback gates.
3) Recommended staffing model for the cutover day (roles + on-call cadence).

We'd like to target a cutover in the week of Jul 10, but we're flexible if your team recommends a different window.

Appreciate the help — can we get a draft by EOD Jul 3?

Best,
Sara
Head of Platform Engineering
StratusML

---
Attachments: stratus_capacity_matrix_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: sara@stratusml.com
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Hosted -> Dedicated migration: sizing check + proposed cutover week

Team —

SARA sent us the numbers above (copied). I did a quick pass with the runtime model and here's our working hypothesis for an initial Dedicated pool that meets the 1500ms p95 SLO with ~20% headroom:

Proposed Dedicated footprint (initial commit):
- 6x A100 40GB-equivalent GPUs (or 8x A100-80GB if using heavier KV caching)
- Estimated sustained throughput: 140 rps (@ avg seq 420 tokens, batching tuned)
- Expected p95 latency: ~1.2s (with continuous batching and per-route prefix cache)

Key assumptions & risks:
- Model variant: rdx-7b-q4 must be validated on our quantized path; if we see quality/regression we may need rdx-7b-int8 (changes GPU memory/capacity).
- Peak concurrency distribution spikes could exceed 95th median; recommend autoscale burst of +2 GPUs reserved for the first 14 days.
- Thermal/maintenance blackout windows: recommend scheduling cutover outside cluster maintenance (avoid 03:00–06:00 UTC ops window).

Cutover proposal (Jul 10–12 UTC sympathetic to East coast evening traffic):
- Day -7 (Jul 3): Final capacity sign-off and DocuSign PO (owner: Stratus).
- Day -3 (Jul 7): Dedicated pool provisioned and smoke-tested with synthetic load (owner: Redwood infra).
- Day -1 (Jul 9): Customer canary traffic routed at 1% (route + tag) for 3 hours, then 5% for next 6 hours (owner: Redwood + Stratus ops).
- Cutover Day (Jul 10): Progressive ramp to 25%/50%/100% across 6-hour windows with verification gates (owner: joint).
- Post-cutover Day +1 (Jul 11): Traffic observation window + ability to fallback to hosted via routing policy (owner: Redwood).

Staffing (suggested for cutover day):
- Cutover lead (Redwood): jonas_weber — coordination and rollback authority
- Infra ops (Redwood): 2 engineers (karthik_iyer, grace_oconnor) — provisioning, scaling, kernel/slot validation
- CS/Customer liaison (Stratus): Sara Lim — acceptance sign-offs and customer communication
- On-call fallback (Redwood): 1 SRE available for 24 hours post-cutover

Deliverables I will attach by EOD Jul 3: detailed cutover runbook (cutover_sanity_runbook_v1.md), a test matrix, and a DocuSign authorization template for you to sign.

Can Marissa/Karthik confirm that the GPU footprint aligns with infra capacity (and any preferences on instance types)? Marissa, Karthik: can you also propose the exact autoscale policies (burst count / cooldowns)?

Thanks — Jonas
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

---
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: sara@stratusml.com
Date: Thu, 05 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Hosted -> Dedicated migration: sizing check + proposed cutover week

Quick responses from infra: we can reserve 6x A100-40GB-equivalent or 5x A100-80GB (cost/slot tradeoff) in us-east-1 for Jul 7 provisioning. Karthik, confirmed autoscale policy recommendation below.

Autoscale policy (proposed):
- Baseline: keep 6 GPUs active for steady-state
- Burst policy: allow +2 GPUs for 10 minutes when p95 latency > 1400ms AND queue-length > 20
- Cooldown: 300s after burst before scale-in
- Canary scaling: For canary, use strict thresholds and ramp only via manual trigger (no autoscale during canary windows)

Staffing ack: I can lead infra ops with Karthik as the primary on provisioning. Grace will own the kernel/quant validation on the actual model variant (run the quantized inference tests and sanity-case prompts).

Canaries & verification checks (operational):
- Functional: model logits sanity, top-k consistency check, sample prompt set (provided by Stratus)
- Performance: p50/p95 latency, token throughput, decoding error rate (unexpected stops)
- Economic: token spend rate <= expected burn rate (guardrail)

I attached the runbook draft and a short checklist. For attachments: stratus_capacity_matrix_v2.xlsx, cutover_sanity_runbook_v1.md.

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Sara Lim <sara@stratusml.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Jul 2028 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: FINAL: Cutover timeline + signature request (D-5478)

Sara —

Thanks for the quick turn. Per internal validation and infra confirmation, we're green for the Jul 10–12 window with the following firmed items:

1) Provisioning: 6x A100-40GB-equivalent reserved in us-east-1 with +2 GPU burst available for 14 days post-cutover.
2) Canary schedule: Jul 9 (1% then 5%) succeeded in dev/test; production canary will follow the Day -1 plan at UTC-friendly times to avoid your peak.
3) Rollback: Immediate routing fallback to Hosted API route; Jonas (me) is the rollback authority given a substantive SLO regression or quality regression flagged by Grace.
4) Staffing: Marissa (infra lead), Karthik (autoscale and provisioning), Grace (model quality checks), Jonas (cutover lead).

Next steps we need from Stratus today:
- Execute DocuSign for the Dedicated PO (link below). DocuSign must be signed by someone with financial authority.
- Confirm the customer prompt set for the functional canary (upload to the shared drive linked).

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/link/stratus-cutover/D-5478
Shared drive for prompts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/stratus-prompts-5478

If we get the signed PO before 20:00 PT today we will provision the pool on Jul 7 and run the staging smoke tests.

Jonas Weber
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
